title: ‘Our SpaceX shares are worth more than a bn’: Binance's CZ responds to Musk's trolling as hack investigation continues
summary: Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao urged Elon Musk to stop mocking the exchange after a major breach, noting that Binance had invested $500 million in Musk’s Twitter takeover. Binance says about $3 billion in customer funds have been located and is reviewing security.

title: Meta's AI spending has cost its rating? S&P downgrades credit outlook to AA- as ‘ability to monetize limited’
summary: S&amp;P Global Ratings lowered Meta’s AA- outlook to negative, citing rising leverage and heavy AI spending whose returns remain uncertain. The move signals a possible downgrade within two years, though Meta’s rating is not currently under review.&nbsp;

title: Why Swiggy’s Toing is raising questions over food-delivery profitability
summary: Swiggy’s affordable-meal app is showing early signs of attracting new and returning users, but analysts are questioning whether it can drive incremental demand without adding to the company’s costs.
